blockedIdentities.reason: The bare Soderhamn record does not safely distinguish the former Soderhamn Eriksson identity from the city name and later USNR business continuity. No current manufacturer-owned source supports publishing it as a standalone canonical manufacturer.

TAEHA matches unrelated active Korean manufacturers: one publishes mechatronic control equipment while another publishes pulse-jet valves for dust collectors. The repository record has no discriminator that selects one identity safely.
TAIYO is shared by multiple unrelated Japanese industrial manufacturers and brands. The undifferentiated record has no legal-name, product-scope or domain evidence that resolves the intended entity.
TECHNICAL SRL is a generic legal name used by unrelated companies. No manufacturer-owned domain, legal identity and product-scope combination could be tied unambiguously to the repository record.

TEKA is shared by unrelated appliance and industrial extraction-equipment identities. The bare manufacturer record provides no product or legal discriminator, so automatic publication would risk a wrong-brand page.
TEKO is a generic short name used by several unrelated manufacturers and technology companies. No authoritative discriminator in the repository selects one current industrial entity.

TESCH is a legacy relay-manufacturer identity acquired by Rockwell Automation. No current first-party source supports it as a standalone commercial manufacturer, and a separate current profile would risk misrepresenting ownership and production status.

profiles.shortDescription: SYSTEM RES designs and manufactures handling solutions for bottles, jars and other hollow-glass containers. Its official scope covers custom grippers, palletising and depalletising, conveyors, shuttle cars and inspection equipment.
fullDescription: SYSTEM RES' manufacturer-owned site establishes the French hollow-glass handling specialist and its in-house production capability.

The documented portfolio supports glass factories, bottlers and decorators with gripping components, vacuum plates, belts, rollers, spacers, conveying equipment, pallet handling and inspection machines.

profiles.shortDescription: Systemair develops ventilation and air-handling equipment for commercial and residential buildings. Its official range includes fans, air-handling units, air-distribution products, ventilation systems and heaters.
fullDescription: Systemair's manufacturer-owned product directory confirms the Swedish ventilation identity and its broad air-movement and climate-equipment scope.

The published portfolio combines commercial and residential air-handling units with fans, air-distribution components, ventilation systems and heating equipment designed for integrated building solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Tadano manufactures lifting equipment for construction and industrial operations. Its official range covers all-terrain, rough-terrain, city and crawler cranes together with pick-and-carry cranes, knuckle-boom cranes and aerial work platforms.
fullDescription: Tadano's manufacturer-owned global site establishes the lifting-equipment identity and documents machines for varied terrain, load and access requirements.
The current portfolio spans mobile and crawler crane formats, compact and articulated lifting systems and aerial work platforms, supported by official technical documentation and service resources.

profiles.shortDescription: TAJMAC-ZPS manufactures machine tools for precision and series production. Its official program includes vertical, horizontal, gantry and multi-axis machining centres, multi-spindle automatic lathes and sliding-headstock machines.
fullDescription: TAJMAC-ZPS' manufacturer-owned production program establishes the Czech machine-tool identity and its current CNC equipment scope.

The documented families cover machining centres for complex milling and turning, MORI-SAY multi-spindle automatic lathes, MANURHIN K'MX sliding-headstock machines, automation and digital production services.

profiles.shortDescription: TAKEX develops sensing, security and control equipment under the Takenaka Engineering identity. Its official catalog includes intrusion detectors, access-control and alarm devices, wireless systems, cameras, safety monitoring and automatic-door sensors.
fullDescription: Takenaka Engineering's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes TAKEX as its equipment brand and confirms the Kyoto company identity.

The documented range combines security detectors and control panels with wireless and video equipment, safety and temperature monitoring, leak detection, vehicle sensing and sensors for automatic doors and industrial control.

profiles.shortDescription: Taylor Hobson develops metrology equipment for surface, form and optical measurement. Its official AMETEK profile documents contact and non-contact systems including Form Talysurf, Talyrond and LUPHOScan instruments.
fullDescription: AMETEK's first-party business profile confirms Taylor Hobson as its Leicester-based metrology business and documents a history dating to 1886.
The verified portfolio covers surface texture and form measurement, roundness and cylindrical analysis and non-contact optical metrology for precision manufacturing and research.

profiles.shortDescription: TBMA designs and supplies components and systems for handling powders and granules. Its official portfolio includes rotary and diverter valves, feeders, samplers, loading chutes, big-bag systems and pneumatic or mechanical conveying.
fullDescription: TBMA's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Dutch bulk-solids engineering identity and more than fifty years of project experience.
The documented scope ranges from individual valves, feeders and samplers to filling, discharge, conveying, storage, mixing and homogenising systems for hygienic and heavy industrial duties.

profiles.shortDescription: TBT Tiefbohrtechnik manufactures deep-hole drilling machines and tools and provides contract drilling. Its official range covers standard and special machines, single-lip and double-lip drills, indexable-insert and high-speed tools and machine services.
fullDescription: TBT's manufacturer-owned site confirms the German deep-hole drilling technology identity and more than sixty years of specialization.
The documented offering combines machine series for different drilling duties with tooling, grinding equipment, retrofit, spare parts, remote service and contract manufacturing.

profiles.shortDescription: TDE MACNO is a historical industrial-automation identity continued within BDF Digital. The official successor source links it with servo drives, frequency inverters, numerical controls and complete automation systems.
fullDescription: BDF Digital's first-party company history documents the merger of TDE MACNO and ECS and explicitly preserves both as recognized automation brands.
Current group capabilities developed from that continuity include servo drives, CNC controls, complete automation systems and energy-conversion solutions for machines and industrial plants.

profiles.shortDescription: TDI manufactures turbine air starters and air-driven auxiliary motors for diesel and gas engines. Its official portfolio includes TurboTwin, TurboStart and TurboTwister starters for marine, mining, oil and gas and power-generation applications.
fullDescription: TDI's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the Dayton company and its battery-independent turbine starting technology.
The documented range covers inertia- and pre-engaged air starters across multiple engine sizes together with air-driven pump motors and auxiliary oil-pump motors for demanding operating environments.

profiles.shortDescription: TECHNIBAG designs and manufactures filling machines and packaging lines for liquids in flexible bags and bag-in-box formats. Its official range spans semi-manual, semi-automatic and automatic fillers, complete FLEXI-LINE systems and peripheral equipment.
fullDescription: TECHNIBAG's manufacturer-owned site establishes the French liquid-packaging engineering identity and its in-house equipment scope.

The documented portfolio scales from lower-volume standalone filling machines to multi-head automatic lines, with buffer tanks, box erectors, vacuum bag packers and box-sealing equipment for food, beverage and non-food liquids.

profiles.shortDescription: Technifor is the industrial-marking identity that became part of Gravotech. Official Gravotech material connects the brand with laser, dot-peen and scribing technologies for permanent part identification and traceability.
fullDescription: Gravotech's first-party Technifor history confirms the identity while presenting it as a predecessor brand within the current Gravotech organization rather than an independent company.

The associated equipment scope covers integrable laser markers, marking stations and mechanical marking systems used for industrial identification, manufacturing traceability and permanent component marking.

profiles.shortDescription: TECNA manufactures industrial resistance-welding systems, tool balancers and vehicle-body repair equipment. Its official range includes spot welders, press welders, robot guns, welding transformers, inverters and multiple balancer lines.
fullDescription: TECNA's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the Italian industrial-equipment identity and its resistance-welding specialization.

The documented portfolio combines manual and automated welding machines with controls, transformers and measuring instruments, plus spring balancers and repair technologies for production and workshop applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Tecnocablaggi manufactures electrical transformers and magnetic components under the TC Transformers identity. Its official portfolio covers transformers, autotransformers, reactors and related accessories for industrial power applications.
fullDescription: Tecnocablaggi's manufacturer-owned site confirms the Italian legal identity, the TC Transformers presentation and production history beginning in 1980.
The documented range includes standard and engineered transformers, voltage-conversion autotransformers, line and load reactors and supporting electrical accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Tecumseh develops refrigeration and cooling products for commercial, household, transport, medical and industrial applications. Its official families include compressors, condensing units, unit coolers, chillers and DC-powered refrigerated systems.
fullDescription: Tecumseh's manufacturer-owned product-family directory confirms the current refrigeration-equipment identity and its broad application coverage.
The documented portfolio spans multiple compressor platforms, packaged condensing units, unit coolers, chillers, mobile refrigerated units and battery thermal-management systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Teguma manufactures moulded rubber products and sealing components in Halberstadt. Its official range includes rubber seals, sheets, fabrics, hose products and application-specific mouldings for rail and industrial uses.
fullDescription: Teguma's manufacturer-owned site establishes the German family business and documents rubber-product manufacturing dating to the nineteenth century.
The published range combines standard materials with custom moulded parts, seals, cut components, sheets, rubber fabrics and rail-vehicle products developed from application requirements.

profiles.shortDescription: TEIKOKU manufactures sealless canned-motor pumps and related process equipment. Its official portfolio includes canned-motor and metering pumps, canned-motor agitators, electric oil pumps and designs for high-temperature, high-pressure and slurry service.
fullDescription: TEIKOKU's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the Japanese process-pump identity and its canned-motor technology scope.
The documented range supports chemical, refrigeration, semiconductor, energy and high-pressure applications with multiple pump configurations, metering equipment, agitators and auxiliary components.

profiles.shortDescription: Teknomotor designs and manufactures electric motors and electrospindles for machining soft materials. Its official range includes high-frequency motors and manual, quick and automatic tool-change spindles, blade units and custom solutions.
fullDescription: Teknomotor's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Italian spindle and motor identity and states production experience since 1983.
The documented portfolio supports CNC routers, edgebanders, robotic applications and equipment for wood, aluminium, plastics, composites and eyewear processing.

profiles.shortDescription: Tektronix develops electronic test and measurement instruments. Its official portfolio covers oscilloscopes, probes, spectrum and signal analyzers, signal generators, source-measure units, power supplies and software.
fullDescription: Tektronix's manufacturer-owned product directory confirms the electronic test-and-measurement identity and its laboratory and engineering scope.
The documented instruments support waveform acquisition, RF analysis, signal generation, semiconductor characterization, power testing and automated measurement workflows.

profiles.shortDescription: Telcomec designs and manufactures electromagnetic and pneumatic clutches and brakes for industrial power transmission. Its official range covers tooth, disc and friction designs with standard and customized configurations.
fullDescription: Telcomec's manufacturer-owned site confirms the Italian legal identity, its 1993 establishment and in-house clutch and brake manufacturing.

The documented equipment supports packaging, textiles, construction, ceramics, conveying and other automated machinery, with engineering from application analysis through prototypes and series production.

profiles.shortDescription: TELEA continues within Telea Tecnovision as an industrial video, vision and communication technology identity. The official portfolio covers high-temperature process cameras, industrial television, machine vision, security video and industrial intercom systems.
fullDescription: Telea Tecnovision's manufacturer-owned site states that it acquired TELEA in 2011 and integrates that identity into its current industrial video engineering business.
The documented solutions include cameras for furnaces and other high-temperature processes, CCTV and security systems, industrial vision equipment and communication systems for demanding plants.

profiles.shortDescription: Teledyne Technologies develops advanced digital imaging, instrumentation, aerospace and defence electronics and engineered systems. Its official scope includes imaging sensors and cameras, monitoring and control instruments, harsh-environment interconnects and electronic test equipment.
fullDescription: Teledyne's first-party corporate profile establishes the current technology group and its focus on industrial markets requiring advanced technology and high reliability.

The documented product scope spans visible, infrared and X-ray imaging; marine and environmental instrumentation; electronic test and measurement; aerospace information systems; satellite communications and engineered systems for space, defence, environmental and energy applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Telemecanique Sensors develops industrial sensing and machine-safety products. Its official portfolio covers proximity and photoelectric sensors, limit and pressure switches, safety detection, RFID identification and machine connectivity.
fullDescription: Telemecanique Sensors' manufacturer-owned portfolio document confirms the current industrial-sensor brand identity and its licensed operation within YAGEO Group.
The documented range combines discrete and process sensing with safety systems, RFID, cabling and connectivity products for machine builders and automated production environments.

profiles.officialName: Tellarini Pompe S.n.c. di G. Tellarini & C.
profiles.shortDescription: Tellarini Pompe manufactures self-priming and centrifugal pumps for transferring liquids. Its official range includes brass and stainless-steel electric pumps, bare-shaft pumps, drill pumps, jet pumps, autoclaves and filter groups.
fullDescription: Tellarini's manufacturer-owned product catalog establishes the Italian pump identity and its focus on compact liquid-transfer equipment.

The documented families cover corrosion-resistant and food-compatible models, direct-current and asynchronous-motor units and accessories for industrial, chemical, agricultural, marine, beverage and household applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Telstar develops engineering and process equipment for life-science, laboratory and high-vacuum applications as part of Syntegon. Its official portfolio includes aseptic systems, sterilization, freeze dryers, laboratory cabinets, ultra-low-temperature freezers and vacuum chambers.
fullDescription: Telstar's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Syntegon Telstar legal identity and its focus on pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, food, laboratory and research projects.

The documented scope combines GMP consultancy and engineering with barrier and laminar-flow systems, sterilizers, industrial and laboratory freeze dryers, cold-storage equipment, helium leak detection and thermal-vacuum chambers.

profiles.shortDescription: Temposonics is the current identity of the former MTS Sensors division and specializes in magnetostrictive measurement technology. Its official range covers industrial and mobile-hydraulic position sensors, compact light-industrial sensors and liquid-level transmitters.
fullDescription: Temposonics' manufacturer-owned history documents the 1984 formation of the MTS Sensors division, Amphenol's 2021 acquisition and the return to the Temposonics company name.

The current product directory covers contactless absolute linear position and liquid-level measurement, with sensor families for factory automation, hydraulic cylinders, compact OEM equipment, hazardous areas and process vessels.

profiles.shortDescription: TENTE manufactures castors, wheels and powered mobility systems for equipment and material handling. Its official range covers light- to extra-heavy-duty castors, wheels, mounting accessories, motorised drives and application-specific mobility solutions.
fullDescription: TENTE's manufacturer-owned international site establishes the German mobility-equipment identity and manufacturing history since 1923.

The documented portfolio supports healthcare, intralogistics, autonomous mobile systems, machinery, workshops, aerospace, cleaning, furniture, catering and retail with configurable castors, wheels and electric drive components.

profiles.shortDescription: Termomeccanica is an Italian engineering group focused on environmental technologies and energy recovery. Its current official scope covers waste-to-energy systems, biogas extraction and industrial process technologies rather than the pump and compressor businesses it divested.
fullDescription: Termomeccanica's manufacturer-owned history establishes the La Spezia group, its 1912 origin and its current environmental-engineering direction.

The official source records the 2022 divestment of industrial pumps and the 2025 sale of the compressor business, while documenting current group work in waste-to-energy combustion, furnace systems, biogas extraction and related process engineering.

profiles.shortDescription: TESCOM is Emerson's pressure-control brand for industrial and laboratory fluid systems. Its official scope covers pressure regulators, valves and engineered control solutions for gases and liquids.
fullDescription: Emerson's manufacturer-owned TESCOM brand page confirms the current group identity and its specialization in precise pressure and flow control.
The product scope serves applications that require controlled delivery of high-purity, high-pressure or process media through regulators, valves, manifolds and configured systems.

profiles.shortDescription: TESEO develops modular aluminium piping and workstation systems for compressed air, vacuum, nitrogen and other fluids. Its official range includes pipework, manifolds, drop columns, air-and-electric tracks, swinging arms, workbenches and modular trolleys.
fullDescription: TESEO's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the Italian fluid-distribution identity and its aluminium modular-system specialization.
The documented portfolio supports workshop and industrial networks with reusable piping, fittings and distribution assemblies plus ergonomic equipment for assembly and production lines.

profiles.shortDescription: Texas Instruments designs and manufactures analog and embedded semiconductor products. Its official product directory covers amplifiers, data converters, power-management devices, microcontrollers, processors, interfaces, sensors and logic components.
fullDescription: Texas Instruments' manufacturer-owned product-category directory establishes the semiconductor identity and its broad analog and embedded-processing scope.
The documented portfolio supports signal conditioning, power conversion, sensing, connectivity and real-time control across industrial, automotive, communications and electronic systems.
